title: Implementation Manager
job_description:
Implementation Manager

Join our professional-services team to deliver successful SaaS launches for new customers. You will own implementation plans, coordinate technical and business stakeholders, and make each go-live transition smooth.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years coordinating SaaS implementations, customer onboarding, or deployment projects.
- Experience managing project plans, issue logs, training, and go-live readiness.
- Experience coordinating customer data migrations with technical contacts.
- Strong customer stakeholder-management and post-launch handoff skills.
- Experience integrating customer systems through REST APIs.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience coordinating CSV or SFTP data imports.
- Experience using SQL to validate migrated data.
- Healthcare compliance certification.
